source_reconciliations.subject: Kos monastery count
source_reconciliations.decision: The official summary says 16 monastic churches while its current exact roster names 17 monasteries, 12 on Kos and 5 on Nisyros. All 17 exact named current bodies are published and the mismatch is recorded rather than silently changing the roster.

source_reconciliations.subject: Karpathos Saint Mamas
source_reconciliations.decision: Saint Mamas on Kasos appears in both the monastery list and the shrine list. It is published once as the monastery rather than manufacturing a duplicate body.

source_reconciliations.subject: Body contact boundary
source_reconciliations.decision: Public office, church, monastery, and explicit institutional contact lines are carried. Telephone numbers printed only beside named current clergy are omitted. The Panormitis and Patmos domains are carried as body-owned sites after both answered and identified their bodies.

source_reconciliations.subject: Patmos dependencies beyond the Dodecanese
source_reconciliations.decision: The current official Exarchate roster names nine metochia elsewhere in Greece. They are current Greek subordinate bodies and remain under the Patmos monastery parent rather than being reassigned by geography.
